quest.title: Sara's Worries
quest.description: Sara's delivery of ingredients still hasn't arrived, and she's growing more anxious by the minute...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Mora x18000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Find Sara and ask about her commission

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Got it. I'll set off right away!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Amber! Are you here to help out with Jean's commission?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Oh, hi. Yeah, I was just getting ready. Who better than an Outrider to mop up some hilichurls on the delivery route?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Sara... What are you still stressing about? I'm an Outrider, and I won't disappoint!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: You misunderstand me. I don't doubt your abilities, I'm just overwhelmed at the number of orders piling up in front of me.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Another bizarre order came in just now. It's like they're hosting a banquet or something...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: *clears throat*...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything we can help with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can help with the cooking!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Really! You don't mind helping?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: That would be wonderful! You really are the Good Hunter's guardian angel.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Yeah well... Those hilichurls are going to be a handful, too.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Well, why don't you take this order. Start by getting the ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Are you sure {NICKNAME} can be trusted? It might end up tasting a bit funky...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: We're well past the point of aiming for perfection. This is now a fight to save the Good Hunter's business.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A fight?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: For this dish, we need... <color=#00E1FFFF>three Sweet Flowers and three Fowls</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Okay, go and get ready. You too, Amber. I'll be waiting here.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: O—Okay...

talks.objective: Collect 3 Sweet Flowers and 3 Fowl each

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: You're back — have you brought the ingredients? Let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: ...Yep. That's everything.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Now — order number seven is for one <color=#00E1FFFF>Sweet Madame</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And so begins the story of us becoming basic kitchen hands!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: You did say you'd help Good Hunter out — be sure to serve it while it's hot.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: One Sweet Madame, received!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Mmm, it smells... pretty good! You have a knack for this — just the person I need!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Hmm, since you cook so well... You might as well take this <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color> next.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color>! We tried that before, with Amber!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: That's right, a mainstay of the Good Hunter menu. It's my pride and joy!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: The Knights order it almost every time they come here for a gathering.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Let me teach you the recipe for a <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, didn't you say it's your pride and joy? You're going to teach us how to make it, just like that?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: With your cooking skills, I don't think you will be doing a disservice to the Good Hunter brand! Hee-hee.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: As soon as that <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color> is ready, please bring it here.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Have you brought me <color=#00E1FFFF>three Sweet Flowers and three Fowls</color>? Let me see...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Submit cooking ingredients

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Any news on that <color=#00E1FFFF>Sweet Madame</color>?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Submit dish

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: One Sweet Madame, received!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Mmm! That smells absolutely divine! This is nothing less than what I would expect from a head chef, never mind a sous-chef...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Hmm, since you cook so well... You might as well take this <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color> next.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color>? Paimon's sure she's heard Amber and Kaeya mention this one before.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: That's right, a mainstay of the Good Hunter menu. It's my pride and joy!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: The Knights order it almost every time they come here for a gathering.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Let me teach you the recipe for a <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, didn't you say it's your pride and joy? You're going to teach us how to make it, just like that?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: With your cooking skills, I don't think you will be doing a disservice to the Good Hunter brand! Hee-hee.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: As soon as that <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color> is ready, please bring it here.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Is it ready? Let me see, let me seeee!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: This is a very good effort. I think you really captured the essence of what the dish is all about.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are we released from kitchen duty now?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Yes, thanks ever so much for your help. Amber should be able to take care of everything else.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: If you ever get tired of being an adventurer, there'll be a job waiting for you at Good Hunter if you want it!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: I'm still waiting on one <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color>. Have you got it?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Submit dish

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Is it ready? Let me see, let me seeee!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: This is... Wow. Did you really cook this? This is quite simply astonishing. You were born to be a head chef!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are we released from kitchen duty now?

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Yes, thanks ever so much for your help. Amber should be able to take care of everything else.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: If you ever get tired of being an adventurer, there'll be a job waiting for you at Good Hunter if you want it!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Three sweet flowers and three fowls</color>, please. Thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Where's that <color=#00E1FFFF>Sweet Madame</color> up to? Hurry, we have service standards to maintain...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: One <color=#00E1FFFF>Sticky Honey Roast</color>, please. I thought I taught you the recipe already?
